title: Self-Reports Do Not Identify Self-Models: An Identifiability Test for Counterfactual Reports
reasons: 未找到 LLM / Agent 评测对象与基准主题的共同证据
missingSignals: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Self-report benchmarks should include environment-shift invariance tests under fixed intervention before treating accuracy as evidence for an autonomous report mechanism.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across three open instruction models, wrong-source demonstrations move reports toward the source answer family, while explicit mechanism binding reduces this pull.
